newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-LADY LUCK SMILES AGAIN ON DEVERS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-LADY LUCK SMILES AGAIN ON DEVERS.

text.p: Lady Luck smiled on Gail Devers once again on the opening day of the world indoor championships on Friday when she squeezed into the final of the 60 metres.
The Olympic 100 metres champion appeared to finish third behind world record holder Irina Privalova and Greek Ekaterini Thanou in the first of three semifinals.
With only two from each semifinal qualifying for the final, American Devers received an initial reprieve when she was given the same time of 7.15 as Thanou and the pair were placed equal second.
The times were then taken to a thousandth of a second and as a result Devers was awarded second place while Thanou was eliminated. The final decimal place was not released.
Devers retained the Olympic 100 title in Atlanta last year by five-thousands of a second ahead of Merlene Ottey, a decision the Jamaican still disputes.
